hypotheses.C1_native_channel_sum_is_exact: All native bilinear channels reconstruct the restricted derivative with relative R-squared at least 0.999.
hypotheses.C2_static_512_is_sufficient: At least half of active addresses reach held-out derivative R-squared 0.90 using 512 fixed training-ranked channels.
hypotheses.C3_oracle_256_is_sufficient: At least half of active addresses reach held-out derivative R-squared 0.90 using 256 context-selected channels.
hypotheses.C4_context_selection_matters: Median oracle-minus-static R-squared at 256 channels is at least 0.10.
hypotheses.C5_native_ranking_beats_random: Every address's static top-512 set exceeds the 95th percentile of eight fixed random-512 controls.
hypotheses.C6_channel_program_is_sparse: Median per-state effective contribution support is at most 512 channels.
hypotheses.C7_channels_interfere: The median ratio of summed individual channel energy to squared total derivative norm lies outside [0.8, 1.2].
